The '''Douglas system''' was a part of the [[Centrality/Legends|Centrality]] [[Sector/Legends|sector]] in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It was situated at the endpoint of the [[Falko Run]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]], which linked it to the [[Paulking system/Legends|Paulking system]].<ref name="TEA" /> The third [[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] position in the [[Star system/Legends|star system]] was occupied by<ref name="Gamer5" /> the terrestrial<ref name="SWR">[[Star Wars: Rebellion (video game)|''Star Wars: Rebellion'']]</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Douglas III]]. The Douglas system was named after the famous [[Hunting/Legends|hunter]] [[Mendel Douglas]], who traversed Douglas III<ref name="Gamer5" /> at some point by [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]]<ref name="Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of [[Star Wars: The Lando Calrissian Adventures|''The Lando Calrissian Adventures'']] novel trilogy, of which ''[[Lando Calrissian and the Mindharp of Sharu]]'' is the first installment, between [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]] and [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]]. Since by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the events of ''Lando Calrissian and the Mindharp of Sharu'' [[Douglas III]] had already been named and since {{GamerCite|5|A Campaign Guide to the Centrality}} establishes that that name honored [[Mendel Douglas]], who had visited the [[Planet/Legends|planet]], Douglas's visit to Douglas III must have occurred at some point by 3 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].</ref> in order to hunt down the planet's elusive [[jackelope]] creature, but he never returned from the expedition.<ref name="Gamer5" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Douglas system was first mentioned in "[[Twinkle, Twinkle Little Star, How I Wonder Where We Are]]," a [[1990]] [[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game|roleplaying game]] source article published in the [[Voyages SF 13|thirteenth issue]] of the ''[[Voyages SF]]'' magazine,<ref name="Twinkle">{{VoyagesCite|13|Twinkle, Twinkle Little Star, How I Wonder Where We Are}}</ref> based on the mention of Douglas III in ''[[Lando Calrissian and the Mindharp of Sharu]]'', the [[1983]] first entry in the [[Star Wars: The Lando Calrissian Adventures|''The Lando Calrissian Adventures'']] trilogy of novels written by [[L. Neil Smith]].<ref name="LCMS">''[[Lando Calrissian and the Mindharp of Sharu]]''</ref> "Twinkle, Twinkle Little Star, How I Wonder Where We Are" placed the system in the [[Jospro sector/Legends|Jospro sector]].<ref name="Twinkle" /> The article is considered [[Canon|noncanonical]] with respect to the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity.<ref name="Unlicensed">{{UnlicensedStatus}}</ref>

In [[1998]], Douglas III, and therefore the Douglas system, made its first appearance in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars: Rebellion (video game)|''Star Wars: Rebellion'']], which also placed it in the Jospro sector.<ref name="SWR" /> The [[Wizards of the Coast]] [[Star Wars Roleplaying Game|roleplaying game]] source article "[[A Campaign Guide to the Centrality]]"&mdash;authored by [[Michael Kogge]] and published in the [[Star Wars Gamer 5|fifth issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Gamer]]'' magazine<ref name="Gamer5" /> on [[July 24]], [[2001]]<ref name="GamerDate">{{SWArchive|url=gaming/other/rpg/news20010627.html|text=''Gamer'' #5. A Domain of Evil it is.}}</ref>&mdash;marked the first time the name of the Douglas system was featured in a ''[[Star Wars]]'' source canonical with respect to Legends.<ref name="Gamer5" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the system in grid square U-8.<ref name="TEA" />
